_comment: Slice-1 registration of the Gate-1 pre-decision framing hook. Merge the 'hooks' block below into your project's .claude/settings.json (or .claude/settings.local.json for a personal/TEST setup). 'timeout' is in SECONDS (UserPromptSubmit's default is 30s; the hook self-aborts at 28000ms and returns its honest result before this kill). At Slice 3 this same hook is registered via a plugin's hooks/hooks.json using ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} instead of ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}.
